name: Sawada Toshiyuki
source:
An executive of the Exoskeleton Company and the boss of [url=/c86163]Misaki[/url]. He always appears calm with a neutral expression. It's impossible to tell what he is thinking.

[spoiler]The son of a member of the Committee of 300, Sawada is later revealed to be working with others against the Committee in secret, and helps Kaito to defeat [url=/c79016]Kimijima's[/url] plans.[/spoiler]
